summary: Bounded concurrent distinct-client_id session openings batched into one Writer::apply_group transaction (reserve R4, amending ADR 0048 LIFECYCLE_IN_FLIGHT = 1). Distinct non-destructive Open flights run concurrently up to MaxConcurrent under headroom and distinct-client guards, while exclusive transitions (takeovers, destructive CleanStart, Close, Detach, Expire) run strictly serialized when no other flight is active. Configurations prove capacity, single-flight-per-client, exclusive isolation, and idle consistency, witness multi-open group commits, and check three targeted mutants removing each guard.
not_replayed: All safety invariants, multi-open batching reachability, and mutant counterexamples are replayed by concurrent_distinct_opens_pipeline_and_serialize_conflicts_and_exclusives (distinct-client guard, capacity headroom guard, exclusive close/takeover serialization, out-of-order result application) and burst_of_distinct_session_opens_batches_into_fewer_log_commits (real Writer::apply_group batching of concurrent session opens).
